description: This file defines a decorator class for SelectedDisplayField entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set associated DisplayField objects by ID and employs traits for entity management.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayFieldDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class to add additional behavior and helper functions to SelectedDisplayField entities in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a SelectedDisplayField entity.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldById
methods.description: Sets the display field of the SelectedDisplayField entity by ID, fetching the DisplayField reference.
